chunks.head: on one's way to
chunks.note: 表示正朝某地进发的途中。
chunks.ex_en: The children were on their way to school when it started to rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们正在上学的路上，天就下起雨来。

chunks.head: starve to death
chunks.note: to death 是夸张收尾，表“到死的程度”；这里是字面的饿死。
chunks.ex_en: Without food or water, the lost dog nearly starved to death.
chunks.ex_cn: 没有食物和水，那只走失的狗差点饿死。

chunks.head: by this time
chunks.note: 指到叙述所说的这个时间点为止。
chunks.ex_en: By this time, most of the guests had already gone home.
chunks.ex_cn: 到这时候，大多数客人都已经回家了。

chunks.head: in confidence
chunks.note: tell sth in confidence = 把某事作为秘密告诉,望对方保密。confidence 此处指“信任、私密”,非“信心”。
chunks.ex_en: She told me in confidence that she was leaving her job.
chunks.ex_cn: 她私下告诉我，她要辞职了。

chunks.head: get on the track of
chunks.note: track 意为“踪迹”;on the track of sth 指发现并循着线索追下去。
chunks.ex_en: The police finally got on the track of the missing car.
chunks.ex_cn: 警方终于查到了那辆失踪汽车的线索。

chunks.head: get under way
chunks.note: 原为航海用语(船开动),引申为“(事情)开始、动身”。
chunks.ex_en: The meeting finally got under way after a short delay.
chunks.ex_cn: 稍稍推迟之后，会议终于开始了。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 表示不拖延、立即。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher told us to sit down at once.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师叫我们立刻坐下。

chunks.head: short cut
chunks.note: 指比常规路线更近、更省事的走法,也可喻省力的办法。
chunks.ex_en: We took a short cut through the park to save time.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们抄近路穿过公园，好省点时间。

chunks.head: run across
chunks.note: 指不是刻意去找而碰巧碰到某人或某物。
chunks.ex_en: I ran across an old friend at the train station yesterday.
chunks.ex_cn: 昨天我在火车站偶然碰到一位老朋友。

chunks.head: keep something quiet
chunks.note: keep sth quiet = 不让别人知道某事。quiet 此处指“不外传”。
chunks.ex_en: Let's keep it quiet until the plan is ready.
chunks.ex_cn: 计划定下来之前，咱们先别声张。

chunks.head: in the lead
chunks.note: 指处在最前面的位置,竞赛或行进中居首。
chunks.ex_en: With one lap to go, our runner was still in the lead.
chunks.ex_cn: 还剩一圈时，我们的选手仍然领先。

chunks.head: quiet down
chunks.note: 指由喧闹或激动转为安静、平和。
chunks.ex_en: The class quieted down as soon as the teacher walked in.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师一进来，全班就安静了下来。

chunks.head: go on
chunks.note: 本章指“继续往前走”;也常表“继续做某事、发生”。
chunks.ex_en: After a short rest, they went on down the trail.
chunks.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他们继续沿小路往下走。

chunks.head: hang around
chunks.note: 指在某处闲待、盘桓不去。本章 Huck 认为鬼魂会在钱旁徘徊。
chunks.ex_en: Some kids like to hang around the shop after school.
chunks.ex_cn: 有些孩子放学后喜欢在店门口逗留。

chunks.head: occur to someone
chunks.gloss: (念头)突然出现在某人脑中；想到
chunks.note: 主语通常是 idea/thought,表示某想法忽然冒出来。

literal.note_cn: 此处指念头“出现”,非“发生事故”

chunks.ex_en: It never occurred to me that he might be lying.
chunks.ex_cn: 我从没想到他可能在撒谎。

chunks.head: make a fool of oneself
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(“what fools we're making of ourselves”),故 card-only,本章不画虚线。
chunks.ex_en: He made a fool of himself by singing off-key at the party.
chunks.ex_cn: 他在聚会上跑调唱歌，出尽了洋相。

chunks.head: in vain
chunks.note: 表示努力没有结果、白搭。
chunks.ex_en: They searched the whole house for the key, but in vain.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们把整栋房子都找遍了，却是徒劳。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 略带旧式的说法,意为过一段时间之后。本章写作连字符形式 by-and-by。

literal.note_cn: 单独无实义,须整体记忆

chunks.ex_en: By and by the crowd grew tired and drifted away.
chunks.ex_cn: 过了一会儿，人群累了，渐渐散去。

chunks.head: I bet
chunks.note: 口语,表示对某事很有把握;I bet you… 加强语气。

literal.note_cn: 此处非真的“打赌”,表“肯定”

chunks.ex_en: I bet you can't guess who I saw today.
chunks.ex_cn: 我敢说你猜不到我今天见到了谁。

chunks.head: at one's heels
chunks.note: heels 指脚后跟;at sb's heels 表示紧随其后。
chunks.ex_en: The puppy followed the boy everywhere, always at his heels.
chunks.ex_cn: 小狗到哪都跟着那男孩，总是紧随其后。

chunks.head: sure enough
chunks.note: 用来说明事情正如所料地发生了。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 sure 连用表“果然”

chunks.ex_en: I said it would rain, and sure enough, it poured all afternoon.
chunks.ex_cn: 我说过会下雨，果然，整个下午都在倾盆大雨。

chunks.head: at last
chunks.note: 指经过等待或努力之后终于实现。
chunks.ex_en: After hours of walking, we reached the top at last.
chunks.ex_cn: 走了好几个小时，我们终于到了山顶。

chunks.head: fool around
chunks.note: 指闲混、消磨时间或胡闹。fool 此处作动词“胡闹”。
chunks.ex_en: Stop fooling around and finish your homework.
chunks.ex_cn: 别瞎混了，把作业写完。

chunks.head: the coast is clear
chunks.gloss: 没有危险了；周围没人(可以行动了)
chunks.note: 习语,指没有人监视或阻拦,可以放手去做。
chunks.ex_en: He waited by the door until the coast was clear, then slipped out.
chunks.ex_cn: 他在门边等到没人，才溜了出去。

chunks.head: keep someone waiting
chunks.gloss: 让某人等候；使某人久等
chunks.note: 指因迟到或拖延而让别人干等。
chunks.ex_en: Hurry up—you're keeping everyone waiting.
chunks.ex_cn: 快点，大家都在等你呢。

chunks.head: be used to doing
chunks.note: be/get used to + 名词或动名词,表示对某事已经习惯。注意 to 后接 -ing,非动词原形。

literal.note_cn: 此处 to 后接动名词

chunks.ex_en: She is used to getting up early every morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 她习惯了每天早起。

chunks.head: give someone up
chunks.gloss: 对某人不再抱指望；放弃(等某人)
chunks.note: 本章指“不再指望他来了”。give up 另有“放弃、投降、交出”等义。
chunks.ex_en: When he didn't show up by nine, we gave him up and left.
chunks.ex_cn: 到九点他还没来，我们就不等他了，走了。

chunks.head: stumble on
chunks.note: 指无意中碰见某人或找到某物。也作 stumble upon。
chunks.ex_en: While cleaning the attic, I stumbled on some old photos.
chunks.ex_cn: 打扫阁楼时，我偶然翻到了一些旧照片。

chunks.head: hunt up
chunks.note: 指费力地寻找并找到某人或某物。
chunks.ex_en: I'll hunt up a good spot for us to have the picnic.
chunks.ex_cn: 我去物色一个适合野餐的好地方。
